user.title: Solar Smart Miner — Solar & Grid Setup
user.description: Select the HA entities that report solar production and grid consumption, then provide your OpenRouter credentials.

optional_sensors.title: Solar Smart Miner — Optional Sensors
optional_sensors.description: Optionally select a battery state-of-charge sensor. Leave blank if you have no battery.

safety_thresholds.title: Solar Smart Miner — Safety Thresholds
safety_thresholds.description: Set the temperature ceiling and battery floor. The safety layer stops or throttles miners when these are exceeded.

runtime_settings.title: Solar Smart Miner — Runtime Settings
runtime_settings.description: Choose the active power profile and how often the controller polls.

error.solar_entity_not_found: Solar production entity not found in Home Assistant. Check the entity ID.
error.grid_entity_not_found: Grid consumption entity not found in Home Assistant. Check the entity ID.

abort.already_configured: This solar + grid entity pair is already configured.

init.title: Solar Smart Miner — Options
init.description: Adjust runtime settings. Changes take effect on the next coordinator poll — no restart required.

data.dry_run: Dry-run mode (log decisions without applying them)
data.mock_solar_enabled: Use Forecast.Solar as mock solar data (development only)
data.mock_consumption_enabled: Use total miner power as mock grid consumption (development only)

add_miner.title: Add Miner (optional)
add_miner.description: Add a miner by entering its display name and LAN IP address. Leave both fields blank to skip.

error.invalid_ip: Invalid IPv4 address. Please enter a valid IP (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
